skill.name: Codec Derivation via Shapeless Generic
skill.description: Automatically derive JSON encoder and decoder instances for Scala case classes and algebraic data types using the circe generic subproject, which leverages Shapeless for structural reflection without requiring macros in the core project.
skill.skill_body:
To derive codecs for a custom type: (1) ensure the generic subproject is available as a dependency; (2) import circe.generic.auto._ or use the explicit derivation API; (3) the Encoder and Decoder instances will be synthesized automatically based on the type's structure. This approach avoids manual codec boilerplate and compile-time macro overhead.

## Objective

Generate encoder and decoder instances for custom types without manual boilerplate or compile-time macros in the core project
## Applicable Signals

- Type is a Scala case class or algebraic data type
- generic subproject is available in the dependency tree
- No custom serialization logic is required for the type

## Contraindications

- Custom codec logic is required beyond structural derivation
- Shapeless dependency is not acceptable in the project
- Macro-based derivation is explicitly preferred
- Type contains fields that require non-standard JSON representation

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Add circe-generic to project dependencies'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Import auto-derivation (import circe.generic.auto._) or use explicit derivation API'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Define or reference the target case class or sealed trait'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Invoke encoding/decoding operations; Encoder and Decoder instances are synthesized automatically'}

## Constraints

- The generic subproject must be included as a dependency
- Shapeless must be available on the classpath
- The type must be structurally representable (case class or sealed trait with case class members)

## Cautions

- Derived codecs follow the default structural representation; custom field naming or transformation requires additional configuration
- Performance of derived codecs may differ from hand-written implementations for complex types

## Output Contract

- Implicit Encoder and Decoder instances are available in scope for the target type, enabling automatic JSON serialization and deserialization without manual codec definition.
